author: blu
body: The map and fold family lives in Foreword chapter ListUtils and is cited above, not redefined here. This chapter carried a verbatim copy of map-list, map-list-loop, fold-list and fold-list-loop for as long as anyone can remember, and the copy was harmless only for as long as nothing pulled ListUtils into the compiler's own compilation unit. The moment something did, the two definitions collided, ChapterScoper slug-mangled both, and every for expression in the compiler emitted a mangled callee -- which broke the text round-trip and looked like an emitter bug. Cite the library; do not copy it.
